svg.aria-label: A miss through the fill buffers, the L2 and the prefetchers
svg.text: A miss through the fill buffers, the L2 and the prefetchers

The number of outstanding misses is a hole: the KB bounds it by Little's law and the fill buffer pool is its conjecture. The L2 indexing is measured; the prefetchers are inferred from what they cover.
KB conjecture: one per 64 B line in flight, shared
17 cycle hit: request, lookup, two beats
Shared L2: 12 MiB, 12 ways, 128 B lines, 8192 sets
measured; Map 8 draws it in full
Prefetchers, trained on virtual addresses in the LSU
inferred from what they cover; the throttle is a patent
one entry, illustrative: valid is one bit per 16 B
A second miss joins the entry
no free buffer: the load replays
three loads a cycle and prefetch
Bank write steals a load cycle
prefetched lines written into the banks
copies cap near 150 GB/s on coherence work
its data 17 cycles after the miss
physical address at the L2, measured
set bits span offset and frame
two bits XOR higher frame bits
some strides crowd part of the cache
fill and evict on their own
one half or both to the L1, disputed
order kept per 128 B line, patent
about 7.5 MiB seen by one core
the two hashed bits choose the cachelet
a far placement pays the fabric hop
that hop is the step at 3 MiB
three cores stream through the L2
its latency stays flat under round robin
access map, one per region: A accessed, P prefetched
a stride 2 pattern is matched and extended
large stride and SMS side tables
a GHB of just under 256 entries
covers random access in 15 KiB, not 16
240 lines, the buffer less the probe loop
scans filled lines for 8 B pointer like values
arms after 3 accesses, stride up to 8 KiB
one level, into the L2 not the L1
a 128 entry history filter stops repeats
off only by a privileged HID11 bit
rated every 32 cycles by the L2
credits cap a region near 4 in flight
lines evicted unused are denied, patent
non temporal loads skip the L1 fill
stride and region into the L1D
DMP and temporal into the L2 only
Our test for the shared pool
a stride stream keeping 16 lines in flight
plus a pointer chase: if it slows, one pool
64 GB/s at 97 ns is about 48 lines of 128 B
the L2 miss queue depth to look for
DRAM fills enter the L2 and the L1
the SLC takes only L2 victims
one core sweeps about 20 MiB on chip
